frontmatter.name: deep-strategy-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Audit-and-fix convergence optimizer for trading strategies, indicators, strategy cards and their backtests, one pass per evaluation method (273 passes, 9 families: data integrity, out-of-sample, multiple testing, risk metrics, robustness, costs and execution, regimes, indicator quality, reproducibility). Classifies strategy vs indicator, skips inapplicable passes, applies Medium+ fixes, verifies with the project's tests, loops to convergence. Opt-in `--promote` runs a gated champion-challenger climb; "no promotion" is normal. TRIGGER: "run dso"; "optimize this strategy"; "evaluate this indicator"; "audit this backtest"; "is this signal real"; "make this strategy more profitable"; "why does this fail out of sample". SKIP: code quality with no backtest semantics to code-deep-optimizer; prose to document-critique; prompts to prompt-deep-optimizer; SKILL.md to skill-optimizer; SQL to deep-query-optimizer; how markets work to trading-and-investing; live order routing to the owning codebase.
whenToUse: audit this backtest for lookahead and cost bugs
evaluate this indicator / scorecard against its outcomes
make this strategy more effective and profitable
this strategy looked great in-sample then died out of sample
check my strategy card against the code
